reason: Add JANUS HRAiN as a read-only associative and coverage overlay without changing the frozen 488-object evidence corpus or any scientific acceptance rule.

authoritative_harvest_input.rule: The 488 frozen source JSON objects remain the only evidence-bearing corpus for this harvest.

hrain_snapshot_rule.timing: Generate both snapshots only after this amendment and the compact parser are committed; both snapshots must report the frozen apparatus commit as sourceCommit/source_commit.
hrain_snapshot_rule.destination: temporary run directory outside tracked repository outputs
hrain_snapshot_rule.mutation: No registry source mutation; no canonical HRAiN asset replacement is required for this experiment.
hrain_snapshot_rule.freshness_rule: Pre-existing HRAiN exports with older source commits are historical overlays only and may not impersonate the fresh apparatus-bound snapshot.

FULL_CURRENT: verify frozen source paths are present in HRAiN memory
surface path-level discovery candidates outside the 488 JSON set
ACTIVE_REGISTRY_PROJECTION: preserve existing read-only graph links as navigation topology

forbidden_promotions: No HRAiN edge may create DIRECT or FAMILY cultural-lineage status.
No HRAiN path proximity may count as provenance for an ancient claim.
No HRAiN association may unlock reverse-prediction scoring or CRI.
No derivative HRAiN/EYE memory export may be counted as an independent confirmation of its own source JSON.
fresh_snapshot_pass_conditions: both snapshot source commits equal the frozen compact-parser apparatus commit
all 488 frozen source files appear in FULL_CURRENT with matching SHA-256
any HRAiN path discovery outside the 488 set is labeled DISCOVERY_ONLY and carries no evidence authority
canonical_seal: HRAiN MAY REMEMBER, CONNECT, AND POINT. IT MAY NOT RETROACTIVELY TURN MEMORY TO EVIDENCE OR ASSOCIATION TO LINEAGE.
